title: Unit – 2 : Session – 1 : SLO – 1  |  Fundamentals of Arrays and Their Operations
sections: 1. contiguous — array elements are stored in contiguous memory locations.
2. 0 — the first index is usually 0 (in C).
3. arr[4] — the 5th element is at index 4.
4. append — adding at the end of a dynamic array.
5. searching — finding the position of an element.
6. shifting — middle insertion requires shifting elements right.
7. data type — arrays are declared as: type name[size];
9. same — all elements share one data type.
10. size (capacity/length) — how many elements it can hold.
12. deletion — removing an element from a position.
13. integer (non-negative integer) — indices must be integers.
14. fixed — size is fixed once declared in C.
15. for — the for loop is the common traversal loop.
